notes: amendment A2 (flutter_js_widget_runtime#18, fixed by IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime PR #10 commit 20697678): the scroll action is a PointerScrollEvent at the center of the surface (a touch drag produces no pointer signal), so the gestureDetector is placed at the surface center and onScroll fires with the documented payload {dx, dy} = the raw scrollDelta sign ({"dx":0,"dy":60} for scroll [0, 60]).
